description: British National Bibliography records are currently available through the Share Family beta linked-data discovery portal for searching publications, works and people. The former anonymous bnb.data.bl.uk SPARQL/RDF service is no longer reachable; no public production replacement API endpoint is currently documented, and Share Family's current API environment requires OAuth login.
resolution_notes: base_url: replace dead legacy host with current BNB portal: https://www.bl.uk/services/collection-metadata-services. docs_url: replace 403 IRO page with the current page: https://www.bl.uk/services/collection-metadata-services. example: no anonymous replacement API curl exists; production API is not yet available and UAT requires login, so curl the landing page: https://wiki.share-vde.org/wiki/ShareDoc%3AAPI_documentation. description: legacy SPARQL API is no longer current; BL lists BNB on the Share Family beta portal: https://www.bl.uk/services/collection-metadata-services.
